fix_summary.defect: The one-shot task installer's default schtasks invoker ran `& schtasks @argList 2>$null` while function-scope $ErrorActionPreference='Stop' was in force. On Windows PowerShell 5.1 the absent-task idempotency /query writes the ordinary 'task not found' line to stderr, which under EAP=Stop with that redirect is promoted to a TERMINATING PowerShell error before $LASTEXITCODE is read. The real rollout (packet 100) therefore aborted at PLAN before any task was created; it rolled back and the host stayed DARK. The Pester suite injected a FAKE schtasks (never hit real native stderr) and ParseFile only checks syntax, so the defect escaped two adversarial review rounds and CI - the exact GFX-COPIER-PARITY-VALIDATOR-FIX-013 lesson.
fix_summary.fix: Every real schtasks.exe call now routes through a single top-level helper, Invoke-GuvfxSchtasksNative, which snapshots the caller's $ErrorActionPreference, scopes it to 'Continue' for the native call ONLY, and restores the prior preference in finally (even on an exception). Under EAP=Continue it merges native stderr into the output stream (2>&1) so a 'task not found' line is a non-terminating ErrorRecord that is discarded (never thrown, never printed), keeps only the stdout lines, and reads $LASTEXITCODE; it touches no filesystem (no temp file to fail on). It never redirects native stderr to the null stream under EAP=Stop and never throws on a non-zero exit. The default $InvokeSchtasks seam now calls this helper; absence is still inferred by the caller from the /query exit code (not from swallowing an exception). Behaviour-preserving: the account-46 pin, 48/CZ/reserved refusals, PLAN/APPLY distinction, disabled + triggerless render, authoritative read-back, idempotency/drift-Replace rollback, no-secret and no-enable/no-run invariants are unchanged.

Windows gate: Install-GuvfxCopierEmitterOneShotTask.RealSchtasks.Tests.ps1 exercises the real schtasks absent-task /query under EAP=Stop (no throw, captured non-zero exit, classified absent, no task created), EAP restoration, and a RULE 11 positive control (the same path finds an existing task). A gate-only mutation-discrimination step proves the regression is non-vacuous.
